question: What is the height of Kanchenjunga peak of the Himalayas?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 2**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct height of Kanchenjunga, the third highest peak in the world, is approximately** 8,598 meters (28,209 feet).**
 
• **Kanchenjunga **is indeed a magnificent mountain located in the** Himalayan range**, straddling the border between Nepal and the Indian state of Sikkim. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The name **"Kanchenjunga" **means **"Five Treasures of Snow"** in **Tibetan,** referring to its five peaks, which are said to represent the five repositories of God: **gold, silver, gems, grain, and holy books.**
 
• The mountain is located on the border of** Nepal and the Indian state of Sikkim**.
 
• It has been a prominent feature in the local cultures and religions due to its imposing presence.
 
• **Kanchenjunga** was first climbed on **May 25, 1955,** by a British expedition led by **Charles Evans.**
 
• However, out of respect for local religious beliefs, they stopped a few feet short of the actual summit.Despite being one of the highest peaks in the world, **Kanchenjunga **is less frequently climbed than** Everest or K2** due to its remote location and the difficulty of its ascent, which is considered one of the most challenging in mountaineering.
